summary_brief: 2026年3月8日，AI编程助手和Agent平台呈现三大核心趋势：安全沙箱架构的精细化升级（多个项目同步引入细粒度权限控制）、插件/技能市场生态的标准化建设、以及跨平台IM集成与Agent通信协议的推进。这些变化标志着AI工具从实验性向生产级可靠性和生态化方向加速演进。

engineering_signals.title: AI代码执行安全沙箱架构精细化演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个主流AI编程助手（OpenAI Codex、Claude Code等）同步引入细粒度沙箱策略，将文件系统与网络权限分离，并引入AI辅助审批流程，标志着AI代码执行安全从粗放式管理进入精细化控制阶段。

engineering_signals.title: AI工具插件/技能市场生态标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex、gptme等项目同时推进插件市场和技能生态系统建设，支持插件发现、安装、验证和发布全流程，推动AI能力模块化和社区化发展，形成可扩展的工具生态。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent跨平台IM集成与通信协议标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: DeerFlow等平台将AI Agent桥接到飞书、Slack、Telegram等主流IM，同时DeepAgents推进ACP协议服务器模式，形成多渠道触达和Agent间通信的双重标准化趋势。

engineering_signals.title: AI思考过程可视化与用户体验提升
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个AI工具（Gemini CLI、Zed编辑器、Fabric）同步引入或增强AI思考过程的可视化能力，将模型推理过程透明化，提升用户对AI决策的理解和信任度。

engineering_signals.title: AI对话数据导出与可移植性能力建设
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme、Dify等工具同步推出对话导出功能（支持Markdown/HTML格式），反映AI助手工具从纯交互向可导出、可归档方向的演进，满足企业合规和用户数据所有权需求。

engineering_signals.title: AI工具从被动响应向主动自动化演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code引入/loop命令和cron调度工具，支持AI按设定间隔自动执行任务（如监控部署状态），标志着AI编程助手从被动问答向主动自动化运维的关键转变。

engineering_signals.title: MCP生态工具链完善与诊断能力增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme等工具为Model Context Protocol服务器提供健康检查和诊断工具，反映AI开发工具对MCP生态的持续投入，提升工具链的可靠性和可维护性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 新增自动化循环调度能力
release_signals.why_it_matters: 引入 `/loop` 命令和 cron 调度工具，使 AI 编程助手能够按设定间隔自动执行任务（如监控部署状态），标志着从被动响应向主动自动化运维的演进。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 引入插件提及系统
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 `@plugin` 提及功能，允许用户在对话中直接引用插件并自动加载相关上下文，大幅提升了工具生态的集成体验和工作流效率。

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Added `@plugin` mentions so users can reference plugins directly in chat and auto-include their associated MCP/app/skill context. (#13510)
- Added a new model-selection surface update so the latest model catalog changes are surfaced in the TUI picker flow. (#13617)
- Merged executable permission profiles into per-turn sandbox policy for zsh-fork skill execution, allowing safer, additive privilege handling for tool runs. (#13496)

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed JS REPL state handling so previously-initialized bindings persist after a failed cell, reducing brittle restarts during iterative sessions. (#13482)
- Treated `SIGTERM` like Ctrl-C for graceful app-server websocket shutdown instead of abrupt termination behavior. (#13594)
- Hardened js_repl image emission to accept only `data:` URLs, preventing external URL forwarding through `emitImage`. (#13507)
- Ensured Linux bubblewrap sandbox runs always unshare the user namespace to keep isolation consistent even for root-owned invocations. (#13624)
- Improved macOS sandbox network and unix-socket handling in Seatbelt, improving reliability for constrained subprocess environments. (#12702)
- Surfaced feedback/diagnostics earlier in the workflow so connectivity and diagnostics are visible before later steps. (#13604)

## Documentation
- Clarified js_repl image guidance (emission and encoding semantics), including clearer usage around repeated `emitImage` calls. (#13639)

## Chores
- Fixed a small codespell warning in the TUI theme picker path. (#13605)

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `/loop` command to run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. `/loop 5m check the deploy`)
- Added cron scheduling tools for recurring prompts within a session
- Added `voice:pushToTalk` keybinding to make the voice activation key rebindable in `keybindings.json` (default: space) — modifier+letter combos like `meta+k` have zero typing interference
- Added `fmt`, `comm`, `cmp`, `numfmt`, `expr`, `test`, `printf`, `getconf`, `seq`, `tsort`, and `pr` to the bash auto-approval allowlist
- Fixed stdin freeze in long-running sessions where keystrokes stop being processed but the process stays alive
- Fixed a 5–8 second startup freeze for users with voice mode enabled, caused by CoreAudio initialization blocking the main thread after system wake
- Fixed startup UI freeze when many claude.ai proxy connectors refresh an expired OAuth token simultaneously
- Fixed forked conversations (`/fork`) sharing the same plan file, which caused plan edits in one fork to overwrite the other
- Fixed the Read tool putting oversized images into context when image processing failed, breaking subsequent turns in long image-heavy sessions
- Fixed false-positive permission prompts for compound bash commands containing heredoc commit messages
- Fixed plugin installations being lost when running multiple Claude Code instances
- Fixed claude.ai connectors failing to reconnect after OAuth token refresh
- Fixed claude.ai MCP connector startup notifications appearing for every org-configured connector instead of only previously connected ones
- Fixed background agent completion notifications missing the output file path, which made it difficult for parent agents to recover agent results after context compaction
- Fixed duplicate output in Bash tool error messages when commands exit with non-zero status
- Fixed Chrome extension auto-detection getting permanently stuck on "not installed" after running on a machine without local Chrome
- Fixed `/plugin marketplace update` failing with merge conflicts when the marketplace is pinned to a branch/tag ref
- Fixed `/plugin marketplace add owner/repo@ref` incorrectly parsing `@` — previously only `#` worked as a ref separator, causing undiagnosable errors with `strictKnownMarketplaces`
- Fixed duplicate entries in `/permissions` Workspace tab when the same directory is added with and without a trailing slash
- Fixed `--print` hanging forever when team agents are configured — the exit loop no longer waits on long-lived `in_process_teammate` tasks
- Fixed "❯ Tool loaded." appearing in the REPL after every `ToolSearch` call
- Fixed prompting for `cd <cwd> && git ...` on Windows when the model uses a mingw-style path
- Improved startup time by deferring native image processor loading to first use
- Improved bridge session reconnection to complete within seconds after laptop wake from sleep, instead of waiting up to 10 minutes
- Improved `/plugin uninstall` to disable project-scoped plugins in `.claude/settings.local.json` instead of modifying `.claude/settings.json`, so changes don't affect teammates
- Improved plugin-provided MCP server deduplication — servers that duplicate a manually-configured server (same command/URL) are now skipped, preventing duplicate connections and tool sets. Suppressions are shown in the `/plugin` menu.
- Updated `/debug` to toggle debug logging on mid-session, since debug logs are no longer written by default
- Removed startup notification noise for unauthenticated org-registered claude.ai connectors

key_changes: 新增 /loop 命令支持定时循环执行提示词或斜杠命令（如 /loop 5m check the deploy）
新增 cron 调度工具支持会话内的周期性提示
新增 voice:pushToTalk 快捷键绑定，支持在 keybindings.json 中重新配置语音激活键（默认空格键）
修复了长时间运行会话中的 stdin 冻结问题，解决了按键停止响应但进程仍存活的 bug
修复了启用语音模式用户启动时 5-8 秒冻结问题（由 CoreAudio 初始化阻塞主线程导致）
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本主要新增了定时循环执行功能，包括 /loop 命令和 cron 调度工具，使用户能够设置周期性任务。同时新增了语音按键重绑定功能，提升了语音模式的可定制性。此外还修复了十余个重要问题，包括长时间会话冻结、语音模式启动延迟、fork 会话计划文件冲突等影响用户体验的关键 bug。

issue_insights.summary_brief: 启动崩溃和静默失败是当前最严重的跨仓库问题：opencode 和 aider 均出现完全阻断主流程的 P0 级启动/运行时崩溃，而 llama_index 的静默 OpenAI 回退存在隐私泄露和合规风险。
global_highlights: 应用启动稳定性问题频发：opencode（inotify耗尽/空指针）、gemini-cli（keytar阻塞20-30秒）、gptme（macOS未签名被拦截）三个仓库均存在启动阶段完全阻断用户使用的问题

平台兼容性缺陷：aider 在 Windows 上 3 个独立用户报告 NotImplementedError 崩溃，gptme macOS 版因代码签名缺失被 Gatekeeper 拦截
SDK/API 集成问题：Anthropic Go/Java SDK 在 Skills API 流式处理和 multipart 表单上存在示例代码失败和 JSON 序列化异常

top_pain_points.topic: Silent OpenAI Fallback in Air-Gapped/Local-First Deployments
